model: TLS weight transmitter with analog output (Modbus RTU)
applies_to: Laumas TLS weight transmitter / indicator with RS-485, installation and user manual version 1.19.
summary: The TLS is a single-channel load-cell transmitter with an analog output and RS-485. With the port set to Modbus RTU it gives gross, net and peak weight, a status word, two inputs and two outputs, two setpoints and the analog-output span as holding registers. Tare, zero, calibration and EEPROM saves are triggered by writing codes to one command register.

addressing.note: The manual prints registers as 40001-40131 and says to subtract 40001 for 0-based clients (40028 -> 27). Its read example asks for start address 0x0007 to read gross weight at 40008, which confirms it.

source.title: TLS Installation and User Manual
source.pages: pp. 25-26 (serial settings), pp. 39-52 (Modbus RTU, register list, status/IO bits, commands, examples)

notes: Host: this copy is hosted by Massload, not by Laumas; a search did not turn up a public copy on laumas.com.

Word order: 32-bit values are H/L pairs, high word at the lower address. The read example returns gross 4000 as 0x0000 0x0FA0 at 40008-40009 and the -56 calibration example is 0xFFFF 0xFFC8 at 40037-40038, so ABCD is documented.

Weights carry no sign and no decimal point: apply status bits 7-9 for the sign and the division index for decimals. Divisions/units register 40014: low byte = division index (0-18: 100, 50, 20, 10, 5, 2, 1 with 0 decimals; 0.5, 0.2, 0.1 with 1; 0.05, 0.02, 0.01 with 2; 0.005, 0.002, 0.001 with 3; 0.0005, 0.0002, 0.0001 with 4); high byte = unit index (0 kg, 1 g, 2 t, 3 lb, 4 N, 5 l, 6 bar, 7 atm, 8 pieces, 9 N m, 10 kg m, 11 other).

Left out: Hysteresis 1 (40021-40022) because its access column is blank in the table; display coefficient 40015-40016 because the manual does not give its scaling for Modbus; exchange registers 40124-40131 whose use is not described.
Command codes 1, 6, 20, 98 and 131 appear in the list with their name printed as display symbols that do not extract; they are not listed.
Setpoints, hysteresis and analog-span values are written to RAM; send command 99 to keep them after power-off. EEPROM allows about 100000 writes.

The manual says the calibration sample weight is a signed 32-bit number; it does not state signedness for setpoints, hysteresis or the analog-output weights, which are typed INT32 here (this only matters for negative values).

integration.summary: Set the serial port to Modbus RTU, then read 40007-40013 with FC3: status word, gross, net and peak weight. Use the status sign bits and the division index (40014) to get the real value. Write 7, 9 and 8 to 40006 for tare on, tare off and zero.
integration.enable: In the serial communication menu choose the Modbus RTU protocol (communication is disabled by default), then set address (1-99, default 1), baud (default 9600), parity (default none) and stop bits (default 1).
quirks: Only FC3 and FC16 are supported; write single registers with FC16.
A settable reply delay (0-200 ms) in the serial menu slows responses.
setup: RS-485: if the line is over 100 m or runs above 9600 baud, close the two RS-485 termination jumpers (120 ohm) on the furthest instruments.
Broadcast writes (address 0) are executed without reply.
gotchas: Outputs can be written only when configured for PLC control in the outputs menu.
Changing the theoretical full scale or the sensitivity resets weight-based settings such as setpoints and hysteresis to their defaults.

registers.name: Command register
registers.description: Write a command code to run it.

values.100: Tare weight zero setting for calibration
values.101: Save first sample weight for calibration
values.6811: Write requested analog output current (value in registers 40122-40123)
values.6812: Read requested analog output current into 40122-40123
values.6813: Write requested analog output voltage (value in registers 40122-40123)
values.6814: Read requested analog output voltage into 40122-40123

registers.name: Status register
registers.description: Weight sign, stability and error flags.

bits.3: Gross weight over 110% of full scale

registers.name: Gross weight
registers.description: Magnitude without decimal point; sign is status bit 7.

registers.name: Net weight
registers.description: Magnitude without decimal point; sign is status bit 8.

registers.name: Peak weight
registers.description: Magnitude without decimal point; sign is status bit 9.

registers.name: Divisions and units of measure
registers.description: High byte = unit index, low byte = division index.

registers.name: Setpoint 1
registers.description: Weight value without decimal point; RAM until command 99.

registers.name: Setpoint 2
registers.description: Weight value without decimal point; RAM until command 99.

registers.name: Outputs
registers.description: Writable only for outputs configured for PLC control.

registers.name: Sample weight for calibration
registers.description: Test weight in divisions; use with command 101/106. Reads 0 after success.

registers.name: Analog output zero weight
registers.description: Weight giving analog zero; save with command 99.

registers.name: Analog output full-scale weight
registers.description: Weight giving analog full scale; save with command 99.

registers.name: Exchange register 1-2 (analog value)
registers.description: mA or V x 10000 for commands 6811-6814 (REGISTER 1 = H, REGISTER 2 = L).
